text:
alex: Quick sync — we're scheduling a signing-key rotation + RBAC tightening for the base-image rebuild. Objective: shrink blast radius, require attestations, and make KMS usage auditable. Proposed canary: 2026-04-14 03:00 UTC. Staged rollout 03:30 UTC.
maria: thumbs-up. Can we enforce ephemeral signer creds (short-lived) and runtime-only permissions for the builder SA?
jen: yes. plan: builder-SA keeps only iam.serviceAccounts.actAs for build jobs; signing-runner-sa gets roles/cloudkms.signer for a 30m token minted by STS. Token minting is logged and audited.
kevin: i'll prepare the owner map for image publishers and repo->artifact mappings. Will also tag images with `org.build.id` and `org.rebuild.run`.
sam: monitoring: for canary we'll run aggressive health checks + vulnerability rescans. If either fails we abort and rollback to the previous stable tag. Who's on triage?
maria: sam primary for kernel/CVE escalations, kevin secondary for container dependency issues. jen owns RBAC + signer workflow.
ops-bot: FYI creating sinks: 1) image-pub events -> gs://images-audit-18mo (retention 18 months) 2) kms-usage -> gs://kms-audit-13mo (retention 13 months). Pubsub alert -> #incidents for unexpected principals.
kms-bot: KMS key prepared: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild-kr/cryptoKeys/rebuild-2026. Binding will restrict asymmetricSign to signing-runner-sa only. Key metadata will be routed to org SIEM.
jen: pipeline changes: add cosign attest step and manifest metadata push. Example commands for pipeline: ```bash
# sign with KMS-backed key
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild-kr/cryptoKeys/rebuild-2026 \
  --predicate ./attest-predicate.json 
# push metadata to registry
gcloud artifacts docker images add-tag $IMAGE $IMAGE:rebuild-2026 --quiet
```
alex: Good. Also ensure predicate contains fields: build_id, git_sha, builder_sa, image_layers_digest. We need those for SCA and forensic queries.
kevin: question on retention: compliance asks for 13 months of KMS usage and 18 months of image events. ops-bot suggested separate buckets which is fine. Can we also mirror KMS logs to the SIEM?
ops-bot: yes, I'll add a sink to forward to SIEM (Cloud Logging -> SIEM) filtered for protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign".
jen: emergency revoke playbook (short form): 1) remove signer binding, 2) disable key version, 3) pause CI tokens. Commands: ```bash
# remove signer permission
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding rebuild-2026 \
  --location global --keyring rebuild-kr --member="serviceAccount:signing-runner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier"
# disable active key version (soft disable)
gcloud kms keys versions disable 1 --key=rebuild-2026 --keyring=rebuild-kr --location=global
# block CI minting
gcloud iam service-accounts disable signing-runner-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
maria: diagnostics to run if canary fails: `kubectl -n canary describe pod <pod>`; `kubectl -n canary logs <pod> -c runtime`; `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND labels.k8s-pod/app=canary" --limit 200` and `cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild-kr/cryptoKeys/rebuild-2026 $IMAGE`.
sam: small improvement: add immutable image labels (LABEL org.build.id) baked at build time so we can correlate registry events -> deploys easily.
kevin: i'll run a staging dry-run this week to verify cosign verify + predicate parsing. Will also test a fake compromised token scenario to validate alerts.
sec-ci-bot: Dry-run completed in staging: cosign sign/verify flow validated. No elevated accesses detected in staging logs.
ops-bot: Maintenance window scheduled for IAM changes: 2026-04-14T02:30:00Z -> 2026-04-14T04:00:00Z. Infra-oncall notified.
maria: Action items recap: 1) kevin -> owner map + staging dry-run (due 2026-04-07) 2) jen -> RBAC policies + pipeline patch (due 2026-04-09) 3) ops-bot -> create sinks + SIEM forward (done 2026-04-10) 4) sam -> triage rota for rollout (confirm by 2026-04-12) 5) alex -> update runbook with revoke steps & playbook (by 2026-04-12).
jen: any objections to requiring ATTEST as a gate in the CI job (fail build if attestation missing)?
maria: no objections. make it a hard gate for production-managed images.
kevin: one last ask — document an escalation matrix specifying who to call (pager, phone) for critical CVEs during the window. I'll draft and share.
alex: thanks all. i'll merge the runbook changes after jen's pipeline PR lands and we'll run the canary as scheduled. :rocket:
